description: A third-party JavaScript library (pace.js v1.2.4) for page load progress indication, including monitoring AJAX requests, DOM elements, document readiness, and event lag.

classes.name: Bar
classes.description: Represents the progress bar element, manages rendering, updating, and finishing the progress indicator.

classes.name: Events
classes.description: Implements event handling with on, off, trigger methods for internal event management.

classes.name: Evented
classes.description: Base class providing event handling capabilities for Pace.

classes.name: NoTargetError
classes.description: Error thrown when the target element for the progress bar is not found.

classes.name: ElementTracker
classes.description: Tracks the loading state of DOM elements based on CSS selectors.

classes.name: ElementMonitor
classes.description: Monitors multiple DOM elements for load completion.

classes.name: DocumentMonitor
classes.description: Tracks the document's readyState to monitor page load progress.

classes.name: EventLagMonitor
classes.description: Measures event loop lag to detect performance issues.

classes.name: Scaler
classes.description: Calculates and updates progress based on source input, smoothing progress updates.

classes.name: AjaxMonitor
classes.description: Intercepts and monitors AJAX and WebSocket requests for progress tracking.

classes.name: RequestIntercept
classes.description: Intercepts native request methods to monitor AJAX/WebSocket activity.

methods.name: runAnimation
methods.description: Runs a custom animation loop with requestAnimationFrame or fallback.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Deep merges source objects into a target object.

methods.name: getFromDOM
methods.description: Retrieves configuration options from DOM data attributes.

methods.name: addEventListener
methods.description: Adds event listeners to DOM objects, with fallback for older browsers.

methods.name: shouldTrack
methods.description: Determines if a request method should be tracked based on options.

methods.name: getIntercept
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the singleton request interceptor.
